title: NEWEST UPDATE — Ticket Message Controls & Support Access
summary: This is the newest HelpDesk update: server logs are ticket-only, ticket customers can be pinged, reply messages can be edited/deleted/restored, and Founders get support ban controls.
added: Added `/ping` to ping the customer who opened the current ticket.
Added `/message edit` to edit the latest reply sent by the staff member in that ticket.
Added `/message config` so staff can edit or delete their latest reply record.
Added `/msg config admin` for Founders to restore deleted replies, edit replies, delete replies, and override normal reply ownership.
Added `/ticket admin` Ban Support and Unban Support options for Founders only.
Added reply tracking for staff-side ticket records and customer DM reply messages.
changed: The configured server-log channel now filters out non-ticket log messages.
Ticket logs, ticket command activity, ticket creation, ticket deletion, claim, unclaim, close, punishment, and support-ban logs remain available.
Founder/Admin role <@&1539005297417519205> can access the new override and support-ban tools.
Support instructions keep the corrected Grey R. mention: <@1263248306264608871>.
removed: Removed non-ticket command activity from the server-log channel.
